title: VITEC EZ TV Platform Server before 8.5.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the upload handler that…
description: VITEC EZ TV Platform Server versions prior to 8.5.0 have an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the upload handler. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to upload arbitrary files by specifying a target filename in the X-FILENAME request header without authentication or file type validation. Malicious ASPX files can be uploaded directly to a web-accessible directory and executed by the web server, enabling remote code execution. Patches are available for versions 8.3.0, 8.3.1, 8.4.0, and 8.4.1. Users on versions before 8.3.0 should upgrade to 8.5.0 or later.
